name: The Black Dragon
description: The Black Dragon King, the guardian of the earth and the lord of the Black Dragon clan, is calm, intelligent and powerful. It has a strong physique, well-developed limbs, and huge wings on its back, which are its iconic features. The dragon scales all over its body are its strong armor, and its jagged teeth, sharp claws, and flexible tail make it invincible. It is domineering and powerful and has appeared in famous games.
